description: These Halloween ghost cookies only need a few ingredients and are so easy to make! 👻  You’ll need: - Cookies or biscuits - White cooking chocolate - Marshmallows - Black icing Method: 1. Melt the white cooking chocolate. 2. Dip the marshmallows into the melted chocolate, then place in the fridge to set for around 30 minutes. 3. Once set, use a black icing pen to add the ghost’s eyes and mouth. 4. Melt a little more white chocolate and add it to the centre of each cookie. 5. Place the chocolate-covered marshmallow on top and allow it to set. A really simple Halloween treat idea that’s perfect for spooky season 🎃 #halloweentreats #halloweencookies #halloween #halloweenideas
